source.notes: Ranged support. Int primary. Her ultimate As One is unique — she merges into an ally.

adapted.adaptation_reason: MaxHp = 150 + 19*21 = 549. MaxEnergy = 0 + 24*13 = 312. Largest energy pool of all 6 heroes — supports her mana-hungry support/healing kit. Ranged → back row. As One (ultimate) adapted as a protective merge buff. Very high Int scaling makes her powerful as the match extends.
